idea.title: UGC agency for small DTC brands, 20% commission

source.text: A UGC agency that connects small DTC brands with creators who film product videos, 20% commission. Launch country US, budget $1,000, 15 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug ugc-agency.

idea.problem: Small DTC brands need a steady flow of product videos for ads and struggle to find and manage creators
idea.solution: An agency that matches brands with creators who film product videos
assumptions: Price is 20% commission on the creator fee, about $175 per video, so about $35 per video
A small DTC brand buys 3-5 videos a month
Main channel is cold email (no channel was named)
Coordination takes 1.5-2 h per video (brief, product shipping, 2 revisions)
US card fee assumed at 2.9% + $0.30 (not verified on the US Stripe page)

confidence.note: Real coordination hours per video and direct-rebooking rates are unknown; a 2-week pilot with 1 brand would pin them down

gross_margin.note: Cash margin ~85% of the $35 cut after card fees, but 1.5-2 h of coordination per video eats most of it at 15 h/week (estimate)

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~$472 (4 months x $118) vs CAC ~$190 incl. outreach hours: about 2.5; repeat orders leak to direct deals (estimate)

pricing_power.note: Billo sells a video with rights from $99; JoinBrands charges 8-15%; a 20% markup has no reason to exist

build_effort.note: No product to build: a one-page offer, a contract template and a Stripe link in under a week

skills_match.note: Needs B2B sales and creative direction; no stated experience, both learnable

capital_needed.note: About $86/month in tools (Instantly $47 + leads $9 + domains) fits the $1,000 budget

time_to_mvp.note: Offer can be live in days; creators are oversupplied and easy to recruit

sales_cycle.note: Small DTC founders buy a few videos within days to weeks; no procurement

channel_readiness.note: No audience; cold email replies 1.5-3.4%; brand side is the scarce side (liquidity hit)

trend.note: TikTok Shop US GMV +68% in 2025, but UGC rates fell 44% and AI video costs $4-11

willingness_to_pay.note: Brands pay ~$154 per video, and the price keeps falling: 44% down in 2025

free_alternatives.note: TikTok Shop Find Creators is free; JoinBrands free plan; R5 cap (free_alternative hit)

competitor_density.note: Billo, Insense, JoinBrands, Collabstr, Fiverr, AI tools and many agencies: 20+ (R5 cap <= 3)

differentiation.note: No edge: same creators, same marketplaces, higher fee

legal_regulatory.note: FTC fake-review rule (up to $51,744 per violation) and usage-rights contracts: compliance work

platform_dependency.note: Demand depends on Meta and TikTok ad spend; TikTok US ban risk ended Jan 2026

market_risk.note: AI UGC at $4-11 per video and 66% of creators offering UGC push prices down

skills.note: No stated sales, marketing or video skills

assets.note: No audience, network or brand contacts

interest.note: Stated goal is side income only

rules_applied.effect: free_alternative hit: free_alternatives held at 2; strong_competitor hit: competitor_density held at 1.5 (<= 3)

tam.reasoning: Allied gives $4.7B for 2022; both define UGC platforms broadly

sam.reasoning: 80,000 US brands buying UGC (10% of 803.5k TikTok Shop US stores, assumed) x 3 videos/month x $154 x 12 months

som.reasoning: 8 clients x $140/month commission x 12 months; capped by 15 h/week of coordination

competitors_found.reasoning: Billo, Insense, JoinBrands, Collabstr, Fiverr, TikTok Shop Find Creators, AfterShip Affiliates, Arcads, Creatify, Elev8or, Influee

demand_trend.value: rising volume, falling price per video

price.reasoning: 20% x $175 average video (Collabstr paid $154, calculator $185, Billo near $200)

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: card fee 2.9% x $175 + $0.30 on the full order (US Stripe rate assumed, not verified); excludes founder hours

gross_margin_pct.reasoning: ($35 - $5.38) / $35; with 1.5-2 h coordination valued at $15/h it falls below 25%

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: lifetime of 4 months assumed: project agencies lose 4.2%/month, but brands rebook creators directly after the first deal

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: 1,000 emails x 2.5% reply x 30% positive x 20% close = 1.5 clients

cac.reasoning: ($86 tools + 10 h outreach x $20/h) / 1.5 clients = ~$190; cash only ~$57

ltv.reasoning: 4 videos x $35 = $140/month - $21.50 card fees = $118/month x 4 months

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Instantly Growth $47 + lead finder $9 (pricing page 2026-11) + ~$30 domains and inboxes

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $86 / $118 per client per month = 0.73, rounded up; $1,000/month side income needs 8-9 clients

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 1 week setup + 2-3 weeks of cold outreach at 1.5-3.4% reply to close the first order

verdict.launch_reason: The user's chosen market, and the largest TikTok Shop and DTC ad market.
verdict.cheapest_test: Cold-email 100 Shopify brands running Meta ads with a $799 pilot (4 videos); stop at fewer than 3 positive replies in 7 days
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 positive replies from 100 cold emails by day 7 -> stop
More than 2 h of coordination per video on the first order -> stop, the hourly rate is under $20
First client rebooks a creator directly within 60 days -> drop the commission model

rescue.change: Sell a fixed monthly creative package ($1,200 for 8 ad-ready videos with hooks), not a 20% commission, to Shopify brands spending $5-30K/month on Meta ads
rescue.why: Lifts pricing_power and ltv_cac: retainers churn 1.6%/month vs 4.2%, and margin moves to the 20-40% agency norm
rescue.requires: Writing ad hooks and briefs; 3 vetted creators on fixed rates

rescue.change: Niche to one vertical (e.g. skincare) and sell human base videos plus AI-generated variants (20 ad variants a month)
rescue.why: Turns AI UGC from a threat into margin and gives a specific difference (differentiation 1 -> 2.5)
rescue.requires: Learning AI ad tools; FTC-safe disclosures for AI content

type_checks.note: Creators are oversupplied (66% of creators now offer UGC); paying brands are the scarce side, so this is B2B sales against Billo at $99
Insense needs 12-month exclusivity and voided refunds to stop bypass; a solo broker has no such lock after the first deal

narrative.answer: **PIVOT**, 56/100. Demand is real, but a 20% broker cut has **no pricing power** against Billo ($99 per video with rights), JoinBrands (8-15% fees) and AI video at $4-11, and brands bypass you after the first deal.
tldr: Brands buy UGC, but the price per video fell 44% in 2025 and AI video costs $4-11.
Billo, Insense and JoinBrands already match brands with creators for less than your 20%.
$1,000/month at $35 per video needs ~30 videos and more hours than your 15 a week.

key_findings.title: Platforms undercut a 20% cut
key_findings.detail: Billo sells a video with usage rights from **$99**; JoinBrands charges a **15%** fee on its free plan and 8% on paid plans.

key_findings.title: Prices are falling fast
key_findings.detail: UGC rates fell **44.37%** in 2025 as creators offering UGC rose from 26% to 66%; AI UGC costs about $4-11 a video.

key_findings.title: Nothing locks the brand in
key_findings.detail: Insense needs **12-month exclusivity** and voided refunds to stop bypass; a solo broker loses repeat orders after the first deal.

narrative.recommendation: Do not launch a 20% matchmaking agency. Test a fixed $1,200/month ad-creative package for Shopify brands spending $5-30K on Meta ads: 100 cold emails in 7 days.
narrative.steelman: Brands keep needing **fresh ad creatives** every 4-8 weeks and TikTok Shop US grew 68% in 2025, so demand is real and growing. The evidence agrees, but the margin goes to whoever owns the brief and the results, **not the matchmaker**.

premortem.cause: Brands compare the offer with Billo at $99 and the reply rate stays near zero
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 3 positive replies from 100 cold emails

premortem.cause: The first clients rebook creators directly and monthly revenue never grows past 2-3 clients
premortem.early_signal: First client asks for the creator's contact or does not reorder within 30 days

premortem.cause: Each video takes 2+ hours of coordination, so $35 per video pays under $20 an hour
premortem.early_signal: First 4-video order takes more than 8 hours

changes.what: UGC rates fell 44% while the share of creators offering UGC rose from 26% to 66%
TikTok replaced its Creator Marketplace with TikTok One and AI tools
TikTok Shop US GMV grew 68% to $15.1B in 2025
The TikTok US joint venture closed, ending the ban risk
AI UGC tools sell ad videos for about $4-11 each

why_now.note: Demand grew, but platforms, oversupplied creators and AI video already compress the broker's margin: the window for plain matchmaking has closed.

icp.who: US Shopify brands with $5-30K/month Meta or TikTok ad spend and no in-house creative team
icp.pays_for_today: Collabstr creators at ~$154 per video, Billo from $99, Fiverr gigs from $35
icp.trigger: Ad creative fatigue: rising CPA on Meta forces a refresh every 4-8 weeks

free_alternative.evidence: TikTok Shop's Find Creators tool is free and JoinBrands' free plan charges a 15% fee, below the 20% asked (2026).

strong_competitor.evidence: Insense claims 115,000+ creators and 3,500+ brands; Billo claims 22,000+ brands and raised $2.5-3.69M (2026).

graveyard.evidence: No UGC agency post-mortem found; adjacent closures: Collective Voice (Dec 2025) and TikTok Creator Marketplace (Apr 2025).

no_distribution.evidence: Cold email works but is weak: 1.5-3.4% reply rates, ~$86/month in tools; r/shopify has ~353k members.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Cash margin is ~85% of a $35 cut after card fees; the real cost is 1.5-2 h of founder time per video (estimate).

weak_demand.evidence: Demand grows: TikTok Shop US GMV +68% to $15.1B in 2025; 'ugc creator' ~135K searches. Price per video falls.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: FTC fake-review rule (Oct 2024, up to $51,744 per violation) needs disclosure clauses; manageable, not a barrier.

saturated_wave.evidence: About 9 look-alikes found (5 Product Hunt UGC launches, 4 UGC-agency courses), dates unconfirmed: below the 10 threshold.

customer.segment: Small US DTC brands running paid social ads
customer.pain: They need 3-5 fresh product videos a month to fight ad fatigue
customer.today: Self-serve platforms (Billo, Insense, JoinBrands, Collabstr), Fiverr gigs, TikTok Shop free samples, AI UGC tools

competitors.name: Insense
competitors.gap: Monthly fee too high for the smallest brands

competitors.name: TikTok Shop Find Creators
competitors.traction_note: Built into TikTok Shop, 803.5k US stores

competitors.gap: No real product handling; FTC risk on AI testimonials

scenarios.name: Pessimistic
scenarios.note: 1 client x 4 videos x $35; card fees and tools eat almost everything

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.note: 4 clients x $140; about 30 h a month of coordination; ~$390 net

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.note: 8 clients reach ~$860 net but need ~55 h a month: the whole 15 h/week

risks.risk: Brands bypass the agency and rebook creators directly
risks.mitigation: Own the brief and the results; charge a monthly retainer, not a commission

risks.risk: AI UGC replaces human creators for low-budget brands
risks.mitigation: Use AI for variants on top of real product videos

risks.risk: FTC liability for scripted fake-customer testimonials
risks.mitigation: Disclosure clauses; no claims of usage the creator did not have
State licence scope and duration in every contract (Insense defaults to 30 days)

test_plan.step: Pick one vertical and list 100 Shopify brands running Meta ads (Meta Ad Library)
test_plan.verify: 100 brands with an active ad and a founder email

test_plan.step: Recruit 3-5 creators from r/UGCcreators at a fixed $100-150 per video
test_plan.verify: 3 creators agree to the rate in writing

test_plan.step: One-page offer: $799 pilot for 4 ad-ready videos with hooks; Stripe payment link
Send 100 personalised cold emails plus 30 LinkedIn messages
Ask every positive reply for a paid pilot
